entries.title: Static Deep Triangular Bill and Compact Puffin
entries.description: One newly authored complete stylised puffin-like seabird in a fixed grounded pose. A compact deep-breasted body and very short thick neck continue into a comparatively broad rounded head with two full pale cheek volumes. The bill is a deep short side-flattened triangular solid, not a long toucan keel or a shallow broad penguin wedge. Two short fully folded side wings, a small low rear tail, two short legs and two broad scalloped web-shaped feet complete the whole. All body, high bill profile, cheek, wing and foot geometry newly drawn; no old penguin or toucan parts imported, recolored or rescaled. One static model zero scenes. Coarse exterior artwork only, no exact species, anatomical scale, feeding, swimming, flying, gait, feather mechanics, animal care, safety, rig, animation or interaction claim.

entries.title: Static Beast Jaw and Open Trough Spout
entries.description: One wholly new stylised carved-beast architectural spout module. A continuous thick U-section material body changes from a broad rear attachment root into an extended low animal jaw; its entire upper trough and front mouth are genuinely open. A short full upper snout bridge crosses only the forward portion, above the lower jaw, leaving a rear open channel into the mouth. Two raised brows with dark stone eyes, two swept ears and two short blunt fang forms belong to the carved head; a complete U-shaped rear collar leaves the channel entrance open rather than capping it. Not a recumbent lion or human statue with a pipe attached, nor the old watering can with a head substituted: no vessel reservoir, overhead carry grip, full animal body or imported sculpture. All visible geometry newly drawn. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z-up, full horizontal-bounds-centred lower-sculpture datum; one uninstalled architecture module zero scenes. Dry decorative game-art only, no host wall or tested mounting, water, drainage capacity, weather resistance, structural cantilever strength, historic monument accuracy, manufacture or safe installation. Fixed overlaps are artistic carved joins, not engineering details. Rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Wheeled Open C Arc and Opposed Head Unit
entries.description: One newly authored complete wheeled C-arm-style static equipment exterior. A continuous low forked four-wheel base carries one shaped rear column and a fixed front carriage. A single thick 240-degree curved C member has actual curved inner and outer walls, closed end faces and a completely absent forward sector. Its upper end carries a full broad blank panel housing and its lower end a full rounded housing, with their opaque inward faces opposed across a genuinely open field. A short side arm carries a small blank opaque control-monitor exterior. No imported old housing, patient bed, service-ring mesh or extracted mechanical subsystem. The entire new organisation differs from a closed deep through-ring scanner and long independent bed, and from two trunnion posts carrying a complete service ring with inward jaws. One complete prop zero scenes, four constant opaque PBR materials, metres Z up, horizontally centred overall bounds and actual four-wheel sole datum. Empty static visual prop only. No patient, radiation, medical image, diagnostic or therapeutic capability, imaging geometry, electrical circuit, sensor operation, mobility, clinical fit, safety, load, manufacturing or engineering performance. Rigging, animation and interaction not made or verified.

entries.title: Fixed Side Door and Stepped Seat Bath
entries.description: One newly authored complete empty short seated-bath appearance in a fixed open-door pose. One shared-vertex thick shell includes the full lower footwell, a genuinely raised rear seat step, rear and side walls, and a low front doorway through the full wall. A whole matching thick door is fixed outward on two rooted vertical hinges, with an open grip attached to its outside. Four full short grounded feet carry the shell, while a rear rim carries the whole fixed tap and two blank controls. A continuous interior grab bar is rooted into the rear wall. This is not the older elongated rolled-lip clawfoot tub resized or the neck-notched pedestal bowl enlarged: the stepped seat-to-footwell cavity and full low side-entry portal form a new connected boundary. No old model or mesh imported. Four opaque PBR roles, metres Z up, horizontally bounds-centred ground datum, one whole prop zero scenes. Empty static visual art only: no person, water, door sweep, seal or watertightness, usable plumbing, drainage, bathing or medical advice, human fit, accessibility certification, ergonomic suitability, load, installation or safety performance. Rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Static Recessed Core and Heavy Stone Giant
entries.description: One complete newly authored fictional stone-giant character in a fixed grounded pose. A broad continuous faceted shoulder torso has an actual front chest recess containing one rooted opaque angular stone core. Its heavy blunt head has two genuinely recessed eye bands and a small recessed mouth. Two squat separated hip/leg stacks terminate in broad full flat stone feet; asymmetrically raised shoulder boulders join massive angular upper and lower arms, broad palms, three separated blunt fingers and one bent thumb per hand. These are whole newly shaped irregular stone masses, not a human worker recoloured, a narrow open-waist plate robot with a rock texture, or a treefolk trunk with its branches shortened. No external pins, steel axles, claw-only hands, control strings, bark crown or imported body meshes. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z-up and full horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One static fantasy character zero scenes. The core is an opaque stone accent, not a light or power system. No anatomy accuracy, sentience, walking, joint operation, balance, structural/load strength, rigging, animation, combat, physics or interaction is supplied or validated.
